title: M5GFX #423: close LP I2C reads with the controller STOP (code-level review)

execution.environment: macOS local; no ESP32-C5 hardware; device profiles up to ESP32-C6/P4; QEMU C6 without an LP I2C controller model; no ESP-IDF or Arduino-ESP32 toolchain

checks.detail: single file +6/-2; force_stop_read = state_read && !isLpPort; expression equivalent when LGFX_LP_I2C_NUM == 0
ToughC5 + UnitNFC 400 kHz: 0/100 before, 100/100 after; regression items 100/100 at 100k/400k; reported by the author, not reproduced here
C6 / P4 untested by the author and unavailable here; failure mode would be a 25 ms stall plus connection_lost on every read
no ESP32-C5 in the local hardware test center
QEMU C6 LP domain returns all-ones for the RTC I2C block and drops writes; no C5 profile and no ST25R3916 model
no ESP-IDF / Arduino-ESP32 toolchain on this host

notes: Review posted as a single Japanese comment; PR left OPEN and no upstream changes were made.
Remaining LP gaps acknowledged by the author: i2c_stop() bus recovery on beginTransaction and the readBytes timeout still cannot reach LP pads.
